title: Secretary of State records for seven companies in existing cases
question: Who are the officers, agents and addresses on file for the companies the existing cases ask about, and is any of them suspended?
finding: All 7 companies are shown as active; none is suspended or forfeited. The filings confirm three ties the cases drew from tax returns: Resilient Strategies' only manager is Tim Ly, the Chinese Progressive Association's chief financial officer, at the Oakland suite the Association itself reports to the charity registry; Urban Place Consulting Group's chief executive is Stephen Gibson (Mid Market Foundation's unpaid executive director is "Steve Gibson"); and Jordan Langer runs NPU, Inc., the lender to Project Wreckless. They weaken one: JIA Technologies' filings name a different officer, not the former Lower Polk director. Azul Works Holding (the closest match to the debarred Azul Works, Inc) and OBS Engineering were incorporated three weeks apart in 2016 by the same incorporator, and OBS now lists the suite named in Azul's articles.
how: Each saved filing (articles, amendments, statements of information) is read as text; scans are read with OCR. Status and formation date are those printed by bizfile Online on 20 November 2026 (the “SOURCE” text). City payments are summed for the exact payee name.
limits: An incorporator is often a lawyer who files for many clients, so a shared incorporator is a weak tie; a shared suite can be a sublease. "Azul Works Holding Inc." may not be the same company as the debarred "Azul Works, Inc". Name matches between a filing and a tax return (Gibson, Ly, Langer) are full-name matches with a second link (the address, the case's own return). Residential addresses are not printed; private officers not already named in a case are not named.

columns.t: City paid this exact name since FY2019

rows.record: Sole manager and agent: Tim Ly (the CPA chief financial officer and CEP Education Fund treasurer in the existing case); principal office 1212 Broadway Suite 700, Oakland, the address the Chinese Progressive Association gives the charity registry, with a resilientstrategiesllc.com contact e-mail; formed at 1042 Grant Avenue Suite 5, San Francisco. Type of business: "Managed services organization".
Chief executive and chief financial officer: the former Lower Polk director, at a residential address (2024 and 2025 statements); qualified in California in June 2021 with an Oakland address.

All three filings (2020-2021) name one officer, who is not the former Lower Polk director, at residential addresses in San Francisco, Oakland and Salt Lake City; type of business "Enterprise software". The filings on disk do not tie this company to him.

rows.entity: NPU, INC. (formerly Pier 70 Partners, Inc. and Activate San Francisco Events, Inc.)
rows.record: Chief executive and director: Jordan Langer (2025 and 2026 statements), who signed the 2014 articles as incorporator; renamed Activate San Francisco Events (Nov 2015), then NPU (Oct 2016); type of business "Event Management, Performing Arts, Public Activation", 88 5th Street.

Chief executive, chief financial officer and director: Stephen Gibson (2017 statement); Steve Gibson was the initial agent in the 2001 articles; a 2021 no-change statement is signed by Stephen Gibson.

Articles of June 2016 name Balmore Hernandez (the AzulWorks chief in the Nuru case) as initial agent at 1555 Yosemite Avenue Suite 2; the 2025 and 2026 statements give one officer at 1400 Egbert Avenue. Same incorporator as OBS Engineering, three weeks apart.

Articles of July 2016, signed by the same incorporator as Azul Works Holding; the 2024 and 2025 statements give 1555 Yosemite Avenue Suite 2 as principal office, the suite in Azul Works Holding's articles. Officers differ from Azul's.
